title: Shortest Subarray to be Removed to Make Array Sorted
description: Find the length of the shortest subarray to remove so that the remaining elements are in non-decreasing order.
pseudocode:
1. Find longest non-decreasing prefix end index (right).
2. Find longest non-decreasing suffix start index (left).
3. Result is min of (n - right - 1, left).
4. Use two pointers to merge prefix and suffix to find smaller removal window.
5. Return minimal removal length.

steps.note: Initialize prefix end index at 0. Array: [1, 2, 3, 10, 4, 2, 3, 5]
Find end of non-decreasing prefix: ends at index 3 (value 10).
Find start of non-decreasing suffix: starts at index 5 (value 2).
Slide pointers to see if connecting prefix[i] and suffix[j] is possible.
